scope: Numerical reproduction of the beta-cell secretion subsystem's equation STRUCTURE from the Dalla Man 2007 / Breda 2001 family (S=gamma*Ipo; dIpo/dt=-gamma*Ipo+Spo split into dynamic dG/dt and static (G-h) terms; dY/dt with a floor branch). Numeric constants are declared engineering placeholders, not fitted or verified literature values (see models/dallaman2007/parameters.json). This protocol fixes comparisons and tolerances before generating the SciPy reference and before writing the TypeScript-vs-reference test assertions.

unitsAndConventions.time: minutes internally in both implementations; the TypeScript public API additionally accepts wall-clock seconds per call and converts explicitly
unitsAndConventions.S: pmol/kg/min, and pmol/min after multiplying by the declared 70 kg reference body mass

parametersUsed: models/dallaman2007/parameters.json (gamma=0.5 /min, K=1.0 pmol/kg per mg/dL, alpha=0.05 /min, beta=0.03 pmol/kg/min per mg/dL, Sb=0.5 pmol/kg/min, Gb=h=91.76 mg/dL, bodyMassKg=70). All status="unverified" except Gb.

scenarios.description: Glucose held exactly at Gb for 60 minutes. Exercises the stationary steady state.
scenarios.glucoseMgDl_of_t_minutes: G(t) = Gb for all t in [0, 60]
scenarios.expectedQualitative: S(t) = Sb for all t (stationary to floating-point precision); Y(t) = 0; Ipo(t) = Sb/gamma.

scenarios.description: An idealized step from Gb to Gb+80 mg/dL, ramped linearly over the first 1-second sample (a true instantaneous step has an undefined derivative; the 1-second ramp keeps dG/dt finite and matches the caller's declared 1 Hz glucose sampling), then held for the remainder of 60 minutes.
scenarios.glucoseMgDl_of_t_minutes: G(t) = Gb + 80 * clamp(t / (1/60), 0, 1) for t in [0, 60]  (i.e. linear ramp over the first simulated second, then constant Gb+80)
scenarios.expectedQualitative: A first-phase secretion spike during the ramp second (K*dG/dt term dominates), decaying toward a new elevated steady state as Y relaxes toward beta*80 with time constant 1/alpha minutes.

scenarios.description: A smooth, analytically-defined OGTT-like glucose excursion: a gamma-shaped rise from Gb, peaking at exactly 160 mg/dL at t=37.5 minutes (within the declared 30-45 minute peak window), returning close to Gb by t=120 minutes.
scenarios.expectedQualitative: Both dynamic (rate-of-rise) and static (level-above-threshold) components contribute on the way up; only the static component (decaying) contributes on the way down once dG/dt <= 0.

referenceSolver.method: scipy.integrate.solve_ivp, method='Radau' (implicit, stiff-capable; the system is not stiff at these rate constants but Radau is used for a high-order, independent cross-check), with a 'BDF' second solver as a cross-check, both rtol=1e-11, atol=1e-14
referenceSolver.glucoseInput: Evaluated analytically at any t from the scenario formula above (not interpolated from discrete samples), so the reference has no sampling error in G or dG/dt.
referenceSolver.independence: The reference script re-derives the ODE right-hand side directly from the scenario formulas and models/dallaman2007/parameters.json; it does not import or call the TypeScript implementation.

typescriptSolver.method: Fixed-step RK4, 8 substeps per 1-second advanceBetaCell() call (i.e. one RK4 step per 0.125-second sub-interval), linearly interpolating G between the previous and current 1 Hz samples and holding dG/dt constant across the call (consistent with the linear interpolation of G)
typescriptSolver.callPattern: One advanceBetaCell() call per simulated second, matching the stated 1 Hz glucose sampling of the caller.

toleranceTsVsReference.appliesTo: S(t) (pmol/kg/min) at every scenario sample point, and Ipo(t), Y(t) at the same points
toleranceTsVsReference.rationale: Both integrators solve the same smooth, non-stiff, low-order (2-state) linear-in-the-forcing ODE; an 8-substep-per-second fixed RK4 is expected to track a high-order adaptive solver to well under 0.05% given the minute-scale time constants (1/gamma=2 min, 1/alpha=20 min) are far larger than the 0.125 s TS substep.

referenceEndpoints.note: Not yet generated at the time this protocol was locked. scripts/reference-beta-cell.py writes them to validation/p4/beta-cell-reference.json, which records scenario definitions, sampled outputs, solver settings, a parameter hash and a script hash, generated strictly after this protocol file existed.

humanValidation.reason: This package reproduces a published model's equation structure with declared-unverified engineering constants (see models/dallaman2007/parameters.json). It is a numerical self-consistency check between two independent integrators of the SAME declared equations and parameters, not a comparison against human secretion data. No human acceptance bounds are set or implied by passing this protocol.

references.use: Confirms the dynamic/static secretion structure and the Gb=91.76 mg/dL default; read in full 2026-09-29.
Confirms the dynamic/static (kG, beta, h, delay) secretion structure; read in full 2026-09-29.
Pins every numeric constant used by both the TypeScript and Python implementations, with per-parameter verification status.
